Settings.Title: opssh Settings
Settings.EnterAccount: Enter the name or ID of an account signed in to 1Password.
Settings.CacheDurationError: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to {0} for each timed cache.
Settings.OverviewDescription: Manage the SSH agent on this PC.
Settings.CoreStatusDescription: The local process that handles SSH requests.
Settings.PendingApprovalsDescription: SSH requests waiting for a decision.
Settings.AgentLockDescription: Locking clears loaded private keys and existing approvals.
Settings.PowerShellDescription: Select opssh as the SSH agent for the current PowerShell session.
Settings.DiscoveryDescription: Connect an account, choose its SSH items, and see which keys are ready to use.
Settings.ProviderAccountDescription: Sign in to the 1Password desktop app. Under Settings → Developer, turn on Integrate with 1Password SDKs. Complete any verification in the 1Password window.
Settings.DesktopAccessDescription: The result of the most recent request to 1Password.
Settings.PublicIndexDescription: Discover SSH items and refresh their public keys.
Settings.UsableKeysDescription: Indexed public keys are available to SSH. Private keys load after approval or when you preload them here.
Settings.PoliciesDescription: Manage SSH approvals and how long opssh keeps them and loaded private keys.
Settings.LoadedPrivateKeysDescription: Clear private key material from the local cache.
Settings.ProcessApprovalsDescription: Clear approvals granted to SSH clients and hosts.
Settings.KeyApprovalsDescription: Revoke approvals for the key selected on the 1Password & keys page.
Settings.KeyCacheDescription: Controls how long loaded private keys are kept in memory.
Settings.ApprovalCacheDescription: Controls how long process approvals can be reused.
Settings.AboutDescription: opssh connects Windows SSH clients to SSH keys stored in 1Password.
Settings.CoreVersionDescription: Version reported by the bundled SSH agent.
Settings.IndexReadyDescription: Discovery completed for the current scope.
Settings.IndexPartialDescription: Some SSH items could not be indexed. Refresh to try again.
Settings.IndexUnavailableDescription: The index could not be refreshed. Check 1Password access and try again.
Settings.IndexScopeTooBroadDescription: Narrow the scope to index up to 64 keys. Discovery can scan up to 256 vaults and 8,192 entries per eligible vault. If the account exceeds the vault limit, use an account with fewer vaults. If a vault exceeds the entry limit, exclude it and remove its item include rules, or reduce its entries.
Settings.IndexConnect: Connect an account to discover SSH keys.
Settings.IndexRefresh: Refresh the index to discover SSH keys.
Settings.KeyErrorInvalid: The item has an unsupported or invalid SSH key.
Settings.KeyErrorMismatch: The private key differs from the indexed public key. Refresh the index.
Settings.KeyErrorIndexMissing: The public index entry is missing. Refresh the index.
Settings.KeyErrorGeneric: The key could not be loaded.
Settings.AppearanceDescription: Choose how opssh looks and which language it uses. Changing the language reloads Settings and discards unapplied edits.
Settings.LanguageDescription: Choose the language for Settings, approval prompts, and the tray menu.
Settings.ThemeDescription: Choose a theme for Settings and approval prompts.
Settings.AppearanceSaveFailed: Could not save the appearance settings.
Update.TrayVersionDescription: The installed version used to check for updates.
Update.CheckDescription: Look for a newer stable release on GitHub.
Update.AutoDescription: Check once when opssh starts and notify you if a newer version is available.
Update.SaveFailed: Could not save the automatic update check setting.
Update.Current: You have the latest stable version.
Update.NoRelease: No stable release has been published on GitHub.
Update.Unavailable: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
Update.NotificationBody: Version {0} is available. Open About in opssh Settings to view the release.
Scope.ListEmpty: Connect an account or refresh the index to list vaults and SSH items.
Scope.OverrideLimit: Keep at most {0} vault overrides and {1} SSH item overrides.
Scope.UnavailableDescription: These rules still apply to the corresponding vaults or items when available.
Scope.Description: Scope controls which SSH keys opssh indexes and uses. 1Password manages account-wide access separately.
Scope.Precedence: An SSH item rule takes precedence over its vault rule. Vaults and items set to Inherit use the nearest rule above them.
Scope.CatalogLimit: The discovery list shows up to {0} vaults and {1} SSH items.
Scope.ApplyDescription: Apply to save your changes. Closing Settings discards unapplied changes.
